snippet.title: Version 1.8 Danqing Season | Danqing Island Preview
snippet.description:
🎬Version 1.8 Danqing Season | Danqing Island Preview
Bound by fate and brought to life by vibrant brushwork and colors, the scroll slowly unfolds—go to Danqing Island and explore wondrous landscapes unseen until now!

🖌New Ability Outfit "Danqing Craft"
Ability [Danqing]: Can be used to inject color into objects that have turned to ink, restoring them to their original form.
This ability can only be used within Danqing Island.
How to Obtain: Start the exclusive quest on Danqing Island to obtain the sketch of the four-star Ability Outfit "Danqing Craft" for free in the Heart of Infinity.
🖌New Gameplay Features on Danqing Island
Various new gameplay features will be available, including "Danqing Trails" and "Five-In-A-Row." Explore the unknown scenes within the painting and make your way through the mysterious realms!
🖌New Collectibles on Danqing Island
Go to Danqing Island to collect [Whim Jades] and [Danqing Jade Souls]. Exchange them for generous rewards!

——
The Coziest Open-World Game!
Infinity Nikki Version 1.8 "Danqing Season" launches globally on July 29 (UTC-7)!

#InfinityNikki
